summary: Implementation plan to replace the first six creature emojis (Noodle Cat, Soggy Toast, Disco Duck, Cactus Bro, Cyber Frog, Lava Llama) with original pre-rendered 2D canvas characters featuring distinct silhouettes, thick #1B1040 outlines, glossy eyes with open/closed blink frame swapping, and creature-specific CSS transform idle animations across vault plates, the hatch reveal modal, and the upgrade modal.
